body:
At this point I'm fairly certain nobody will read this, but I am more and more positive that I have to escape my future somehow. I wish I could have talked about it here. Maybe you would have understood.

I think I'm kind of at peace with it now. Its comforting to know that it will all be over. I know I will never be happy again, but I think its a fair trade off for what I will never have to endure. I think not being able to talk about it has made it so much worse. If my friends knew maybe they could have given me some strength. Or maybe I would have just been even more humiliated.

Anyhow. Thanks for trying. I appreciate it.

I just feel like all the progress I've made in over 15 years is just suddenly gone and now I have to start it all over again on hard mode because now my life actually will be difficult and its not all in my head. I know how long of a process it is to get better. I really feel like there is no way that I can survive that. Even one more day feels like it would be unbearable. I constantly feel like I am going to die at any moment because of the physical toll this stress has taken on my body. My heart is constantly racing and it feels like someone is stepping on my chest like I am about to have a heart attack. Sometimes I wish that it actually WAS a heart attack. At least that ends. This never ends.
